source: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India. SRS Based Abridged Life Tables 2020-24 (published May 2026), pp. 20-42.
columns: age = start of interval; n = interval width (null for the open 85+ interval); nqx = probability of dying in the interval; lx = survivors of 100,000 at age x; nLx = person-years lived in the interval; ex = life expectancy at age x
